verdict.rationale: Kit's API docs confirm a general API for building on the platform and bulk processing support for creating subscribers via OAuth, plus audience tagging/segmentation as a product feature, but there is no explicit documentation of update or suppress/unsubscribe endpoints, nor of custom property/field creation via the API. Missing for 10: explicit update-contact and suppress-contact API endpoints, custom field/property API documentation, and evidence of production-scale throughput guarantees beyond generic 'bulk processing for some common use cases'.
